Monthly VWAP represents the average institutional cost basis over the current month. When price crosses above it, it signals bullish momentum and institutional accumulation, prompting buyers to enter.

Persistent price positioning relative to the weekly VWAP signals sustained institutional order flow imbalance. Trend participants use this volume-anchored baseline to filter noise, entering only when price respects the weighted average direction, thereby aligning with dominant liquidity providers.

Aroon Oscillator measures the time elapsed since the highest high and lowest low within a fixed period to gauge trend strength. A crossover above zero indicates that the most recent high occurred more recently than the most recent low, signaling strengthening bullish momentum and providing a logical entry point for long positions as market direction shifts upward.

When the oscillator crosses below zero, it means the most recent low happened more recently than the most recent high, indicating weakening bullish pressure and strengthening bearish momentum. This divergence offers traders a clear trigger to enter short positions or exit longs to align with the emerging downward trend.

Mechanism detects potential lower fractals by identifying local minima in price. Uses percentile rank approximation to find the lowest low within the recent 2 bars, serving as a proxy for the standard fractal formation which requires forward-looking validation not supported by the schema.
